import os
from xml.dom import minidom

# Show file listing and a snippet of document.xml
for root, dirs, files in os.walk("unpacked"):
    for f in files:
        p = os.path.join(root, f)
        print(f"{p} ({os.path.getsize(p)} bytes)")

print("\n=== document.xml first 3000 chars ===")
with open("unpacked/word/document.xml", "r", encoding="utf-8") as fh:
    content = fh.read()
print(content[:3000])

from xml.dom import minidom

dom = minidom.parse("unpacked/word/document.xml")
W = "http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/wordprocessingml/2006/main"

paras = dom.getElementsByTagNameNS(W, "p")
print(f"Total paragraphs: {len(paras)}\n")
for i, p in enumerate(paras):
    texts = []
    for t in p.getElementsByTagNameNS(W, "t"):
        texts.append(t.firstChild.nodeValue if t.firstChild else "")
    txt = "".join(texts)
    print(f"P{i:02d}: {txt!r}")
